title: Cloud Storage - Photo Backup
summary: Free cloud storage & photo backup. Sync files, share & secure your data.
description:
Cloud Storage – Backup, Sync & File Manager
Keep all your files safe and organized in one place. This cloud storage app automatically backs up photos, videos, audio, and documents, so you never lose what matters.

KEY FEATURES

Fast File Upload & Download
Move photos, videos, audio, and documents to the cloud in seconds, whenever you need them.

Auto Backup & Restore
Automatic photo backup and video backup keep your memories safe. Restore your files anytime, on any device.

Cloud File Manager
Browse and organize everything in one place, sorted into simple categories: images, videos, music, and documents.

Secure File Sharing
Share files and folders with friends or teammates using a simple link, with control over who can view or download.

Flexible Storage Plans
Start with free cloud storage and upgrade your space anytime you need more room — no hidden steps.

Quick Search
Find any file in seconds instead of scrolling through endless folders.

WHY USE THIS APP
Whether you want a reliable backup app for your camera roll, a file sync app to keep your devices up to date, or simple online storage for your documents, this cloud storage app brings it all together in one clean, easy-to-use design.
Download now and give your photos, videos, and files a safe home in the cloud.
